name: enclii-status
description: Enclii Status Page - Multi-tenant status monitoring
//packageManager: apps/status/Dockerfile installs this package STANDALONE (COPY apps/status/package.json pnpm-lock.yaml), so the root package.json pin does not reach that build context. pnpm >=12 also stops reading the "pnpm" field below, which is what turned an unpinned corepack into ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH. Keep in sync with /package.json.
//pnpm-overrides: apps/status/Dockerfile installs this package STANDALONE (COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile), so the workspace-root overrides in /package.json do not reach the production image. These mirror the root list for the transitives that ship in the status image. Keep the two lists in sync. EXCEPTION (#549): the sharp entry here is widened to <0.35.4 while /package.json still reads <0.35.0. Next 16.3.3 pulls sharp as an optionalDependency and the old range stopped below the 0.35.x line, so 0.35.3 (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c, HIGH) shipped in the standalone runner. Widening /package.json too requires regenerating the workspace lockfile, which cannot resolve @janua/ui without NPM_MADFAM_TOKEN; do that in a follow-up with registry access.
